{{Quote|Fixer Twelve recognized the override technology from Operation Starbender, eight years ago. That mission was also an anomaly.|Keeper|<ref name="The Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Isen Four}}</ref>}}
'''Operation Starbender''' was an operation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] overseen by [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]] in [[3649 BBY]]. The operation nearly ended in disaster when a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attacked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] base, but an unknown person&mdash;later discovered to be a member of the [[Star Cabal]]&mdash;used an advanced technology to override the pirate flagship's systems and cause it to detonate.<ref name="The Hidden Throne" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Starbender was first mentioned in Keeper's biography on the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and it was further expanded on in the [[Imperial Agent]] mission "The Hidden Throne".
